Fragments.name: Minimum password lenght
Fragments.description: Template for minimum password lenght equal to 128b security equivalent. Require at the least 1 lowercase, 1 uppercase, 1 number and 1 special character, overall lenght 24 characters, in case of change at the least 1/3 must differ.

Fragments.name: pam_deny-denial
Fragments.description: Always denies access. Used as safety net after pam_succeed_if to ensure no accidental fallthrough.

Fragments.name: pam_env-variables
Fragments.description: Set environment variables based on service or login context. Enables conditional behavior based on login origin (local vs remote).

Fragments.name: pam_exec-command
Fragments.description: Execute external command or script during PAM processing. Flexible module for custom authentication/session logic.

Fragments.name: pam_faillock-lockout
Fragments.description: Lock account after N failed authentication attempts. Protects against brute force attacks with configurable lockout duration.

Fragments.name: pam_limits-resource
Fragments.description: Limit system resources per user: concurrent logins, processes, open files, memory. Prevents fork bombs and resource exhaustion attacks.

Fragments.name: pam_motd-display
Fragments.description: Display system Message of the Day to users at login. Standard PAM session module for informing users.

Fragments.name: pam_namespace-isolation
Fragments.description: Create isolated mount namespace for each user session. Each user gets private /tmp and /var/tmp preventing access to other users' files.

Fragments.name: pam_oath-otp
Fragments.description: Two-factor authentication using OTP (One-Time Password) or HOTP (HMAC-based). Users authenticate with password + 6-digit code from authenticator app. Supporting Android applications like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or Android Authenticator.

Fragments.name: pam_pkcs11-smartcard
Fragments.description: PKCS#11 based smart card authentication using X.509 certificates. Highest security factor for local console authentication.

Fragments.name: pam_succeed_if-conditional
Fragments.description: Check user name or group membership and branch authentication accordingly. Useful for conditional authentication rules.

Fragments.name: pam_time-access
Fragments.description: Restrict user logins to specific days and time windows. Useful for enforcing business hours, contractor access, shift-based access.

Fragments.name: pam_u2f-yubikey
Fragments.description: FIDO/U2F authentication using YubiKey hardware security key. Provides strong second factor for MFA. Supporting for OTP codes use of Android applications like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or Android Authenticator with authentication codes (6-8 digits).

Fragments.name: pam_umask-permissions
Fragments.description: Set file creation permissions (umask) based on user group membership. Enables collaborative file permissions for specific teams.

Fragments.name: pam_unix-basic
Fragments.description: Basic Unix authentication using /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow and /etc/group. Foundation for most PAM configurations.
